hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.ps1" claude SessionStart; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.sh" claude SessionStart; exit 0
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.ps1" claude Stop; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.sh" claude Stop; exit 0
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.ps1" claude SessionEnd; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/capture.sh" claude SessionEnd; exit 0
